verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of role-based access control, permission sets, or restricting investigation or administrative actions to specific roles. The only related items are llms.txt index entries for configuring SAML SSO and SCIM. Those cover authentication and user provisioning, which is adjacent to role-based authorization and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can restrict investigation and administrative actions to appropriate roles
